defect.evidence_quote: This case thus presents the question whether the monitoring of a beeper in a private residence, a location not open to visual surveillance, violates the Fourth Amendment rights of those who have a justifiable interest in the privacy of the residence. defect.proposed_fix: Replace pin-714 with the actual opinion passage at page 714 and set the page/pin metadata accordingly.
